messages:
marie: Quick heads-up — saw a 12% tail latency bump on llama3-13b in nightly perf after changing kernel fallback heuristics. Profile attached.

 dan: ugh, which fallback? selector or runtime -> generic?

 marie: runtime decides kernel_fallback=preferred->generic when head_dim mismatch. Repro: local with patched kernel_selector.

 sanjay: Can you paste the perf flame or perf log? also model config used?

 marie: pasted logs:
```
[2026-03-15 04:12:07] kernel_select: trying avx_kernel -> mismatch head_dim 64 vs 80
[2026-03-15 04:12:07] fallback -> generic_cuda
[2026-03-15 04:12:07] batch_warm: cleared
```

 marie: model config snippet:
```
hidden_size: 8192
num_heads: 64
rmsnorm: true
nonlinearity: silu
rope_theta: 10000
chat_template: minimal
```

 alisa: who changed the fallback heuristics? I thought we had a test gating head_dim compatibility

 dan: that was my change last week to prefer generic if stride_mismatch > 0.1 — meant to fix Mixtral issue

 sanjay: hypothesis: for llama3 the heuristic misclassifies due to rounding in head scaling -> ends up at slow path. Can we add a small microbenchmark to detect selector flip cost?

 perf-bot: nightly: llama3-13b @ gpu-a: p50 22ms -> 25ms (+13.6%), p99 65ms -> 72ms (+10.8%). commit: dan/selector-fallback

 marie: repro script:
```
python perf/run_micro.py --model llama3-13b --seq 1024 --batch 4 --kernel-selector=local
```

 dan: i'll revert for now and add an A/B in canary. also we should consider rope_theta default effect — mixing rope scaling with head_dim rounding can change memory layout alignment which impacts kernel choice.

 alisa: good call. Add a unit that simulates typical chat_template prompt lengths (system + history) to catch cache pressure differences

 sanjay: also KV cache behavior: the fallback to generic resets continuous batching warm path and thrashes KV evictions — that fits the tail bump

 marie: tests to add:
- selector microbench for head_dim boundary
- chat_template long-history perf check
- KV cache eviction simulation

 dan: PR incoming, will include perf numbers and revert commit. tagging @build to run extended perf suite.

 perf-bot: queued extended run (eta ~2h). logs will be on CI.

 marie: thanks. assigning follow-ups:
- dan: revert + canary PR
- sanjay: add KV eviction sim
- alisa: add chat_template scenarios

 alisa: :thumbsup: 

 marie: will update the incident doc if CI confirms. thanks team.
